sulfonic chitosans could be used as a stabilizing agent in AuNP synthesis, and the AuNP/CSs could be used as carriers for the loading of charged drugs.

the AuNP/CSs with sulfonic acid group can be used as a platform for surface electronic payload of drugs and the surface charge and the layer number of charged polymers play important roles in the fluorescence intensity of fluorescent molecules.
